name: heatshield-ai
description: HeatShield AI — Unsupervised Spatiotemporal Climate Intelligence & Heat Safety System

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{execSync}=require('child_process');if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){execSync('npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build',{stdio:'inherit'});if(!fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}}else{execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
